title: Green synthesis and magnetothermal performance of Zn1−XONiX nanocomposites for magnetic hyperthermia applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8243-8254
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07531A, Paper

Sellemhe Brahim Salem, Mohammed Ould M'hamed, Khalidou Ba, Turki Altoub, Ali Z. Alanzi, O. M. Lemine, Mohamed Said Mohamed Sidya
Nickel-doped zinc oxide (Zn1−XONiX, X = 0.05–0.20) nanocomposites were synthesized via a simple and eco-friendly co-precipitation route and systematically investigated for their structural, thermal, magnetic, and magnetothermal properties.
